Bones of the Disir Queen®

Game Kit Components

  • 7 Rune Stones
  • 5 Fate Bones — Wolf, Raven, Serpent, Bear, Stag
  • 10 Ant Tokens
  • 1 Queen’s Coin
  • Lore Scroll
  • Game Legend / Quick Reference
  • Scroll of Contrition
  • Runebearer’s Leather Pouch

Players supply the trinkets to be wagered.

The Queen’s Coin

The Queen’s Coin is an official game component and is used before the first Rune cast. Players choose heads or tails and toss the Queen’s Coin. The winner chooses who will go first, establishing order whenever player order matters even though most game actions occur at the same time.

NO CHAMPION HOLDS FORTUNE FOREVER.
